args.title: Update password reset email link from localhost to correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently links to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...'. This change will update the BASE_URL to use the correct public URL set in the environment variables, ensuring that users receive a link that points to the production server instead of a localhost address.
